name: artifact-workbench
description: A toolkit for creating and organizing an artifact library.

languageModelTools.name: artifact-workbench_create_category
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Allows user to create a category for artifacts. Categories should be a container for a specific element like a contact form with modular input fields or a cta banner that includes styling, javascript, and html content. If a specified category already exists, try a different name as name must be unique to each category.If a category exists that is relevant even if the name is different, artifacts should be added to the existing category without creating a new category to cut down on duplicate categories.

languageModelTools.name: artifact-workbench_remove_category
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Allows user to remove a category for artifacts. This tool will also delete all child artifacts of the specified category.
